SELECT a.`device_code` `deviceCode`, a.`code` `code`, a.`shift_master` `shiftMaster`, a.`gear_position_code` `gearPositionCode`, a.`department` `departmentName`, a.`gear_position_area` `gearPositionArea`, a.`unit_traffic` `unitTraffic`, a.`one` `one`, a.`two` `two`, a.`three` `three`, a.`four` `four`, a.`five` `five`, a.`six` `six`, a.`seven` `seven`, a.`eight` `eight`, a.`nine` `nine`, a.`ten` `ten`, a.`eleven` `eleven`, a.`twelve` `twelve`, a.`total` `total` FROM `water_data_year` a where 1=1
and a.`data_time` = #{param.timeFlag}
and a.`department_id` like concat('%',#{param.departmentId},'%')
and a.`shift_master` like concat('%',#{param.shiftMaster},'%')
and a.`gear_position_code` like concat('%',#{param.gearPositionCode},'%')
and a.`code` like concat('%',#{param.code},'%')
